run_setup_wizard: run the interactive DeerFlow setup wizard to configure LLM provider, search, and execution settings
write_config_yaml: write a minimal config.yaml with LLM provider, search tools, sandbox, and execution configuration
write_env_file: write API keys into a .env file by merging key-value pairs into existing or new env files
run_llm_step: run the LLM provider selection step to choose provider, model, and collect API key interactively
run_search_step: run the web search and fetch provider selection step with optional skip for both providers
